resourceProfile.assessment: Canonical English and the complete Vietnamese source, glossary, review metadata, and UI context were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review generation, queue validation, type checking, focused tests, production build, route checks, and link validation passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A fresh Vietnamese critique confirmed interpolation works but found protected-name drift, chronology and catalog false friends, coil-lead errors, and e-liquid and volume defects.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Vietnamese human review was performed; corrected entries remain machine reviewed.

publicationAuthorization.summary: The owner requested correction commits, not publication or deployment.

findings.summary: Steam Engine and Wire Wizard were translated as ordinary phrases.
evidence: The translation contract protects product identity.
findings.resolution: Restored protected names across shared and calculator labels.

findings.summary: Available by used an agentive preposition, property became real estate, and board became a generic panel.
evidence: These labels describe chronology and electronics catalog data.
findings.resolution: Used an explicit upper bound and technical terms.

findings.summary: Coil leads and their power loss became anatomical legs and loss of strength.
evidence: The fields describe electrical lead wire.

findings.summary: Nicotine concentration was rendered as strength, base as a foundation, and target as shooting.
evidence: These fields define an e-liquid recipe.
findings.resolution: Used explicit formulation terminology and rewrote the warning.

findings.summary: Volume was translated as mass in the coil, juice, and Wire Wizard tools.
evidence: Volume and mass are distinct physical quantities.
